false_positives.description: **Req ID:** 378627 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now. We are currently seeking a Full Stack Developer to join our team in Mumbai, Mahārāshtra (IN\-MH), India (IN). Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain responsive and scalable web applications. * Build intuitive and performant user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks. * Develop robust backend services, APIs, and microservices to support business applications. * Design and optimize relational and NoSQL database solutions. * Implement secure, reusable, and maintainable code following industry best practices. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. * Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and performance optimization activities. * Support application deployment, monitoring, and maintenance in cloud environments. * Leverage AI\-powered development tools, copilots, and LLM\-based services to enhance productivity and solution capabilities. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation initiatives. Required Technical Skills Frontend Development * Strong proficiency in React.js and/or Next.js * Experience with TypeScript * Hands\-on experience with Tailwind CSS * Strong understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and responsive design principles Backend Development * Proficiency in Node.js or Python * Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL APIs * Understanding of authentication, authorization, and API security best practices Database Technologies * Strong experience with PostgreSQL * Experience with at least one NoSQL database such as: * MongoDB * Redis * Knowledge of database design, optimization, and performance tuning DevOps Cloud * Working knowledge of Docker and containerized deployments * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation * Hands\-on experience with at least one cloud platform: * AWS * Microsoft Azure * Google Cloud Platform (GCP) AI Modern Development Practices * Familiarity with Large Language Model (LLM) APIs * Experience using AI coding assistants and copilots (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) * Understanding of prompt engineering and AI\-assisted development workflows * Exposure to integrating AI capabilities into applications is a plus Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Suitable, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * 3–5 years of professional experience in full stack application development. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with microservices architecture. * Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and best practices. * Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and logging tools. * Exposure to AI\-enabled application development and GenAI use cases. * Experience working with enterprise\-scale applications and cloud\-native architectures. About NTT DATA NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD. Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us. NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. false_positives.title: Software Engineer – Internal Platforms & Tools
false_positives.company: Therm-x India Engineering and Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd.
false_positives.description: **Role Summary** Therm\-X is expanding its suite of internal software platforms, tools, and scripts that support engineering, manufacturing, and test operations across the organization — spanning web\-based management systems, database and system integrations, desktop field clients, and automation for test and measurement equipment. We are hiring a Software Engineer to help develop, extend, and maintain these internal systems as part of a small, high\-ownership team based in our India remote support facility. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack software engineering role. **A core part of how we work is AI\-assisted, agentic programming** — engineers work fluently alongside AI coding agents to design, draft, refactor, and test code, and are expected to critically review and take full ownership of the results. A strong foundation in programming and computer science is essential, because the engineer must judge correctness, structure, and maintainability rather than simply accept generated output. The role starts as a single contributor and is expected to grow to a team of two to three as the platform expands. **Key Responsibilities** * **Develop, extend, and maintain** web application features and internal tools across the full stack (backend, database, and front end), from design through deployment. * **Work alongside** AI coding agents as a primary development tool — directing them effectively, then reviewing, debugging, testing, and owning the code they produce. * **Integrate** internal platforms with external systems and services (ERP, Microsoft 365 / Graph, document stores, and internal APIs) to enable reliable data flow. * **Develop** and maintain automation for test and measurement systems — e.g., scripting data capture and control for test chambers and instrumentation — and support the desktop field\-client application used to interface with equipment on site. * **Troubleshoot** bugs, data issues, and integration problems across the platform, reasoning through complex workflows end to end. * **Design and maintain** schema changes, queries, and stored procedures against SQL Server, following the platform's data and audit conventions. * **Produce** clear technical documentation and follow code review and deployment discipline appropriate to a small, remote team. * **Collaborate** with HQ engineering to prioritize work, clarify requirements, and drive continuous improvement of the platform. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** **Education \& Experience** * **Bachelor's degree** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field (a strong programming and CS foundation is required). * **2–5\+ years of experience** building and maintaining web applications or line\-of\-business software systems. **Core Competency – AI\-Assisted / Agentic Programming** * **Demonstrated proficiency** using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or similar) as a day\-to\-day development tool. * **Ability** to critically review AI\-generated code — assessing correctness, security, structure, and maintainability — and to debug and take ownership of it. * **Solid grasp** of software fundamentals (data structures, control flow, APIs, testing) sufficient to direct an agent well and to work effectively when the agent is wrong. **Technical Skills** * **C\# and** ASP.NET Core / .NET — primary application framework. * **SQL Server** (T\-SQL), including complex queries, full CRUD operations, and schema design. * **Vanilla JavaScript**, HTML, and CSS for front\-end work (the platform uses a lightweight, no\-build\-toolchain approach — no heavy SPA framework required). * **Building** and consuming REST APIs and vendor/system interfaces (SDKs, HTTP integrations). * **Python** for specialized services, automation scripts, and interfacing with test and measurement equipment (e.g., test chambers, instrumentation, and data acquisition). * **Strong troubleshooting**, analytical, and system\-level problem\-solving skills. **Professional Skills** * Ability to work independently with high ownership as an early or sole contributor, scaling into a small team as it grows. * Strong written and verbal communication for effective remote, cross\-functional collaboration with HQ (including time\-zone overlap and async work). * Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities. **Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications** * **Experience** with IIS deployment and Windows server environments. * **Familiarity** with Microsoft 365 integration (Graph API, SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate). * **Domain familiarity** of engineering or manufacturing workflows — helpful for understanding the platforms' users and the problems they solve (e.g., ECO/document control, ERP concepts, inspection or quality processes). * **Experience** building desktop applications (e.g., Electron or similar) for field/on\-site use. * **Exposure** to test and measurement or industrial automation — instrument protocols, data acquisition, or interfacing with lab/factory equipment. * **Exposure to** integrating with ERP systems (e.g., Epicor) or other enterprise systems of record. * **Experience** with document/drawing management and configuration/change management concepts. **What You'll Work On** * Feature development and maintenance across internal platform modules (project/task management, document control, ERP integration, inspection, asset/maintenance, and more). * Database and API work connecting internal platforms to internal and external systems. * Automation and tooling for test and measurement systems, plus the desktop field client used with equipment on site. * AI\-assisted development workflows that let a small team deliver at a larger team's pace. * Internal tools and dashboards supporting engineering across the organization. Pay: ₹21,500\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month Benefits: * Paid time off * Provident Fund * Work from home Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Experience: * Product management: 1 year (Required) * Product development: 1 year (Preferred) * Manufacturing: 2 years (Required) * ERP systems: 2 years (Required) Language: * English (Preferred) Shift availability: * Night Shift (Preferred) * Day Shift (Preferred) Work Location: In person
false_positives.reason: Job requires 2–5+ years of experience building web applications, and lists 2 years of manufacturing and ERP experience as required, which is beyond a fresher's typical range.
